events.notes: Composite Scheme of Amalgamation and Arrangement (MCA order 08-Apr-2026, effective 01-May-2026): GSPC (unlisted, ratio 305:10) and GSPC Energy (unlisted) and GSPL (listed) merged into Gujarat Gas Ltd, which was renamed Gujarat Energy Ltd (NSE symbol GUJGASLTD -> GUJENERGY w.e.f. 01-Jul-2026); then the Gas Transmission Business was demerged into GSPL Transmission Ltd (step 2). Only GSPL's merger affects public holders, so GSPC is not modelled. T+1: ex-date = record date (NSE listing shows no separate ex-date). Fractional entitlements consolidated, sold via IDBI Trusteeship and proceeds distributed. Same scheme as candidate c0172 (gujaratgas-2025).
